title: Unit limits: declared maximum compile time and peak memory of one compile unit
description: What one compile unit may cost: the default maximum of wall time and peak memory, and the declared carving debt (measured cost, budget and the carving action) of the units above it. The plan warns before a build starts. / Was eine Kompilier-Einheit kosten darf: die Standardgrenzen für Laufzeit und Spitzenspeicher und die deklarierte Schnitt-Schuld (gemessene Kosten, Budget und Schnitt-Aktion) der Einheiten darüber. Der Plan warnt, bevor ein Bau startet.

reason.en: its unit tests need only serde_json, the surface crate and the snapshot crate, yet the test unit also builds the OS kernel with protocol-laws and mutation-testing, the plugin with artifact-app-testing, both job-worker testkits, geo and geojson: carve the dev-dependencies the tests do not name
